repair_contract.casefold_alias_policy: Equal-valued case-fold aliases are removed while their object paths, spellings, canonical keys, and value hashes are retained in casefold_key_aliases_v0. Unequal-valued collisions fail closed.
repair_contract.current_projection_source: current_target_state plus the exactly matching active workstream
repair_contract.duplicate_workstream_policy: The one non-current historical duplicate workstream identifier is quarantined with stable content-hash record IDs rather than silently rewritten.
repair_contract.legacy_flat_packet_policy: Flattened packet metadata remains compatibility-only and cannot override the registry envelope or current projection.
repair_contract.projection_replacement: The stale embedded active_workstreams projection was removed from the active view and replaced by the exact current row already retained in the historical workstreams catalog.
repair_contract.root_alias_policy: Every authoritative-looking root live/current target alias is normalized to the current projection; flattened current_target_state compatibility fields are governed by an explicit authority-key allowlist.
